name: counter-typography
title: Counter Typography
description: Numeric tweening with tabular figures, an ease-out curve and locale-aware grouping; the width is reserved from the final value so the surrounding line never shifts while counting.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Swiss
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- In View Trigger: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
